v1_invalidation: Gym reset seeds the environment RNG but not action_space.np_random; PuzzleEnv samples action_space during goal-observation construction, so v1 did not fully control reset randomness
hypothesis: after all reset RNGs are controlled, action_weight-10 will either show reproducible transient puzzle progress, supporting a sequential closed-loop bottleneck, or reproducibly fail to change buttons, supporting a contact/control bottleneck
exact_change: seed env.action_space with each evaluation seed immediately before env.reset; preserve both frozen checkpoints, policy RNG, task, episode seeds, horizon, and NFE
expected_if_true: two exact action_weight-10 replays have identical non-timing episode records and at least two episodes show button transitions plus positive best progress
expected_if_false: replay differs, or at least two action_weight-10 episodes have no button transition or no positive best progress

evaluation.replay_equality: episode_records excluding no fields; records contain no latency

interpretation.sequential_signal: at least two of three action_weight-10 episodes have button transitions and positive best progress
interpretation.regression_signal: positive best progress followed by worse final Hamming distance
interpretation.contact_failure_signal: no button transitions in at least two of three action_weight-10 episodes
interpretation.scope: mechanism diagnostic only; three paired episodes are not a benchmark estimate
